An architect? (\textbf{o arquiteto}.) A dentist? (\textbf{o dentista}.) A pharmacist? (\textbf{o farmacêutico}.) A butcher? (\textbf{o talhante}.) A son-in-law? (\textbf{o genro}.) A daughter-in-law?
